character.tag: 1boy, solo, black suit, white shirt, black tie

beats.en: The morning of the vote, he got to the office before anyone else. Made the coffee, like he had every week for eleven years.
beats.ta: வோட்டிங் நடந்த அன்னிக்கு காலைல, அவரு எல்லார்கிட்டயும் முன்னாடியே ஆபீஸ் வந்துட்டாரு. வழக்கம் போல எல்லாருக்கும் காபி போட்டு வெச்சாரு.
beats.si: චන්දෙ දාන දවසෙ උදේ, එයා ඔක්කොටම කලින් ඔෆිස් ආවා. සුපුරුදු විදිහට හැමෝටම කෝපි හැදුවා.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, office kitchen, early morning light, pouring coffee, calm expression, upper body
1boy, solo, black suit, empty boardroom, long table, morning light through blinds, standing alone, wide shot

beats.en: He thought loyalty was something you could save up. Eleven years, he'd saved nothing else.
beats.ta: லாயல்டி ஒரு சொத்துன்னு அவரு நினைச்சாரு. பதினொரு வருஷமா அத மட்டும்தான் சேத்து வெச்சிருந்தாரு.
beats.si: විශ්වාසය කියන්නෙ එකතු කරන්න පුළුවන් දෙයක් කියලා එයා හිතුවා. අවුරුදු එකොළහක් එයා එච්චරයි එකතු කළේ.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, looking at framed photo on desk, office at night, warm lamp light, close up
1boy, solo, black suit, reflection in dark office window, city lights behind, contemplative, upper body

beats.en: Nine fifteen, the doors closed. Nine seventeen, his own brother raised a hand against him.
beats.ta: ஒம்பது பதினஞ்சுக்கு கதவெல்லாம் சாத்திட்டாங்க. ஒம்பது பதினேழுக்கு, அவரோட சொந்த தம்பியே அவருக்கு எதிரா கை தூக்கிட்டான்.
beats.si: නවයයි පහළොවට දොරවල් වහුණා. නවයයි දාහතට, එයාගෙම මල්ලි එයාට විරුද්ධව අත උස්සුවා.
panels: boardroom doors closing, no humans, dramatic shadow, interior, wide shot
1boy, solo, black suit, seated at boardroom table, shocked expression, hands raised around him, dramatic lighting

beats.en: Eleven years. Eleven years of nights in that building. Gone in ninety seconds.
beats.ta: பதினொரு வருஷம். அந்த பில்டிங்ல கழிச்ச பதினொரு வருஷ ராத்திரி. தொண்ணூறு செகண்ட்ல எல்லாத்தையும் புடுங்கிட்டாங்க.
beats.si: අවුරුදු එකොළහක්. ඒ බිල්ඩිං එකේ ගෙවපු අවුරුදු එකොළහක රෑවල්. තත්පර අනූවකින් ඔක්කොම ගියා.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, angry expression, clenched fist on table, boardroom, harsh overhead light, close up
1boy, solo, black suit, standing abruptly, chair pushed back, boardroom, tense, upper body

beats.en: By noon his card didn't open the door. Nobody looked up when he walked out.
beats.ta: மத்தியானத்துக்குள்ள அவரோட கார்டு வேலையே செய்யல. அவரு வெளிய நடந்து போறப்ப யாருமே நிமிர்ந்து பாக்கல.
beats.si: දවල් වෙනකොට එයාගෙ කාඩ් එකෙන් දොර ඇරුණෙ නෑ. එයා එළියට යනකොට කවුරුවත් හිස ඔසවලා බැලුවෙ නෑ.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, holding keycard at door reader, red light, office corridor, defeated, upper body
1boy, solo, black suit, walking away through open plan office, people ignoring him, wide shot, cold light

beats.en: He stood in the rain a long time. Long enough to stop feeling anything.
beats.ta: மழையில ரொம்ப நேரம் நின்னுட்டு இருந்தாரு. எதுவுமே உணராத அளவுக்கு ரொம்ப நேரம்.
beats.si: වැස්සෙ එයා ගොඩක් වෙලා හිටියා. මුකුත් දැනෙන්නෙ නැති වෙනකම්ම.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, standing in heavy rain, city street, night, neon reflections, head down, wide shot
1boy, solo, black suit, soaked in rain, close up, empty expression, neon lights blurred behind

beats.en: Then he remembered the clause. Page forty one. The one nobody else bothered to read.
beats.ta: அப்பதான் அந்த க்ளாஸ் ஞாபகம் வந்துச்சு. நாப்பத்தி ஒண்ணாவது பேஜ். வேற யாரும் படிக்கவே இல்லாத பேஜ்.
beats.si: එතකොට එයාට ඒ වගන්තිය මතක් වුණා. හතළිස් එක්වෙනි පිටුව. වෙන කවුරුවත් කියවලා නැති එක.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, eyes widening in realisation, rain, night, neon, close up
open contract document, page forty one, highlighted clause, no humans, desk lamp, close up

beats.en: He smiled, and walked back toward the building.
beats.ta: அவரு சிரிச்சாரு. அப்புறம் அந்த பில்டிங் பக்கம் திரும்பி நடந்தாரு.
beats.si: එයා හිනාවුණා. ඊට පස්සෙ ආපහු ඒ බිල්ඩිං එක දිහාට ඇවිද්දා.
panels: 1boy, solo, black suit, slight confident smile, rain, night, neon, close up
1boy, solo, black suit, walking toward lit office tower, rain, night, back view, wide shot
